issues.problem: The active API root is versioned; /api alone is only a prefix and is not the documented v1 root.
The response does not match the requested date. October 1, 2024 had four MLB Wild Card games, not 15, and gamePk 775294 was World Series Game 2 on October 26.
issues.suggestion: Replace the snippet with a response captured from the stated schedule request, showing the four October 1 postseason games and their actual gamePk values.

issues.problem: The entry presents profiles, textures, and session validation as one API rooted at api.mojang.com, but session/profile-texture operations also use separate services such as sessionserver.mojang.com and newer endpoints use api.minecraftservices.com.
issues.suggestion: Narrow the description to the UUID/name endpoints hosted at api.mojang.com, or explicitly list the additional Minecraft Services and Session Server roots.

issues.problem: The free-plan allowance is misstated as 40,000 CU per month. Moralis currently advertises 40,000 Compute Units per day, with 40 RPS throughput.
issues.suggestion: Set this to "Free plan: 40,000 Compute Units per day and 40 RPS; attribution required."

issues.problem: A public scan limit is documented: only one new scan per host per minute; requests during the cooldown return a cached result.
issues.suggestion: Set this to "One new scan per host per minute; cached results may be returned during the cooldown."

issues.problem: The description says the current Observatory analyzes TLS configuration. The former multi-tool Mozilla Observatory was sunset in 2024, and the current MDN HTTP Observatory does not provide specific TLS or certificate analysis.
issues.suggestion: Describe it as an HTTP security-header and related web-hardening scanner; remove the TLS-configuration claim.

issues.problem: Current MTA SIRI documentation points to the API at bustime-classic.mta.info, not bustime.mta.info. GTFS-Realtime feeds use yet another host.
issues.suggestion: Use https://bustime-classic.mta.info/api for SIRI and document the separate https://gtfsrt.prod.obanyc.com roots if GTFS-Realtime is included.

issues.problem: The example uses the wrong SIRI host and prefixes MonitoringRef with MTA_, while current documentation specifies the GTFS stop_id itself and demonstrates unprefixed numeric IDs.
issues.suggestion: Use a documented form such as curl "https://bustime-classic.mta.info/api/siri/stop-monitoring.json?key=YOUR_API_KEY&MonitoringRef=401000&LineRef=MTA%20NYCT_M15".

issues.problem: The current developer page says the API is free for anyone; the asserted non-commercial-only restriction and separate commercial approval requirement are not supported there.
issues.suggestion: State that access is free with registration, and only add a commercial-use restriction if the current linked MTA license terms explicitly impose one.

issues.problem: The sample artist data is stale. MusicBrainz currently records Nirvana's life span as beginning in 1987 and ending on 1994-04-05, not 1988 through an undated 1994.
Nansen's current v1 API requires the API key in the lowercase apikey header; Bearer authentication is not the documented alternative.
issues.suggestion: Set the details to "API key via the apikey: YOUR_API_KEY header."

issues.problem: The null value is incorrect. Nansen offers a paid Pro API plan plus purchasable usage credits.
issues.suggestion: Describe the current Pro subscription and flexi-credit pricing, using Nansen's current pricing page for exact amounts.

issues.problem: The cited Free limit of 5 RPM / 500 RPD is outdated. Current documentation states 20 requests per second and 300 requests per minute.
issues.suggestion: Set this to "20 requests per second and 300 requests per minute per API key," subject to future plan changes.

issues.problem: POST /api/v1/profiler/address-portfolio is not a current documented endpoint, and the body does not match the current profiler schema.
issues.suggestion: Use POST https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/profiler/address/current-balance with header apikey and a body such as {"address":"0x28c6c06298d514db089934071355e5743bf21d60","chain":"ethereum"}.

issues.problem: ADS publishes a standard limit of 5,000 regular requests per day for most request types, with endpoint-specific limits also exposed in response headers.
issues.suggestion: Set this to "Typically 5,000 regular requests per day; inspect X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers for the endpoint/token."
